Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver

Class RootModelResolver

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver.RootModelResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
EyeAttachmentResolver, ModelMemo.Resolver<net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?>,Attachment>
public class RootModelResolver extends Object implements EyeAttachmentResolver
Resolver for every model whose geometry hangs off Model.root() — all vanilla models and any third-party model built the vanilla way. It walks that tree by its name → child map, naming the root root, so tokens are slash-joined paths like root/body/head. Matching is a normalized suffix match (see EyeAttachmentResolver.pathMatches(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)), so a stored head still attaches and a stored body/head disambiguates two same-named parts under different parents.

Resolving a token records the chain of parts from the root down to the attach part; applying that chain replays each part's translateAndRotate onto the live (this-frame, post-animation) PoseStack, so the resulting pose carries every ancestor's animation and scale. Baby models are separate model instances whose age scaling lives in their part poses, so the same replay places a baby's eyes. The descent mirrors ModelPart.visit(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack, net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelPart.Visitor), except that it does not skip cube-less pivot/group parts, so eyes can attach to a named empty joint.

It handles every model, so Resolvers tries it last.

    • canonicalToken

      public String canonicalToken(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String storedToken)
      Description copied from interface: EyeAttachmentResolver
      Translate a (possibly differently-spelled or partial) stored attach token into the canonical path token this resolver would enumerate for the same part — the single vocabulary the picker, HUD, and exported configs all speak. That is the full slash path (root/body/head), with a positional segment (#N) only where a part has no obfuscation-stable name. Returns the token unchanged when it can't be resolved to a part (so unknown tokens pass through untouched rather than being silently remapped).

      Default: identity (the resolver's enumeration vocabulary already matches stored tokens, e.g. named bones).

      Specified by:
      canonicalToken in interface EyeAttachmentResolver

    • resolve

      @Nullable public Attachment resolve(net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel<?> model, String partToken)
      Description copied from interface: EyeAttachmentResolver
      Find the part partToken names and return the transforms that reach it, or null when the model has no such part (an unknown token, or a model whose worn variant lacks it).

      The expensive half of the contract: a search of the model's part tree, matching each candidate path against the token. Called once per (model, token) — see AttachmentCache.ATTACHMENTS — so it may allocate and walk freely.
